fabric_motion: fabric enters at the bottom of the frame and exits at the top

expected_score.rule: 4-point: <=3in 1, 3-6in 2, 6-9in 3, >9in 4; holes <=1in 2, >1in 4; max 4 points per linear yard

position_formula: use frames.csv: roll_y_px = roll_y_top_px[frame] + y_in_view; x_on_fabric_px = x_in_view - fabric_x0_px[frame]; yard = roll_y_px / px_per_cm / 91.44; across_cm = x_on_fabric_px / px_per_cm
fixture_note: demo_challenge_roll: simulated AITEX test-source roll; not factory footage
